# AJ Fibertek India Pvt. Ltd.

> AJ Fibertek India is a multi-disciplinary manufacturing company delivering engineered solutions across thermal and acoustic insulation, sintered tooling, and medical implants. AJ Fibertek India Pvt Ltd is part of the Raval Group and based in Pune, India.

All information below is taken from https://ajfibertek.co.in/

## Company

- Legal name: AJ Fibertek India Pvt. Ltd.
- Also referred to as: AJ Fibertek India, AJ Fibertek
- Part of: Raval Group
- Based in: Pune, India
- Established: 2009
- Website: https://ajfibertek.co.in/
- Sectors supported: automotive, industrial, power generation, and healthcare

## About

- [About Us](https://ajfibertek.co.in/about-us/): Company history from 2009, mission, vision, foundational pillars, timeline and awards.

Positioning as stated on the site: "Advanced Materials & Precision Engineering for Critical Applications" — delivering high-performance insulation systems, custom sintered tooling, and medical-grade components to meet the evolving needs of global industries.

Mission: To engineer reliable, high-performance solutions that meet the evolving needs of global industries. We are driven by a commitment to quality, innovation, and long-term partnerships—empowering our clients with excellence in every product we deliver.

Vision: Our vision is to be recognized globally as a world-class innovator in insulation technology. We aim to shape the future through precision engineering, responsible environmental practices, and long-term, client-centric partnerships that drive performance and reliability.

## Divisions and Products

AJ Fibertek operates three product divisions.

- [Thermal & Acoustic Insulation](https://ajfibertek.co.in/thermal-acoustic-insulation/): Advanced glass and silica fiber insulation products, including ECR glass mats and HAMAT® variants, providing heat resistance and sound absorption for vehicles, generators, and heavy machinery. Used in exhaust systems, battery thermal safety, and underbody protection.
- [Precision Sintered Tooling](https://ajfibertek.co.in/sinteredtooling/): High-durability tooling components including core rods, forming dies, and inner/outer punches for sintered part production in metal powder-based manufacturing.
- [Medical Implant Components](https://ajfibertek.co.in/medical-implant/): Medical-grade components including trauma plates and screws, pediatric and arthroscopy implants.

### HAMAT® insulation range

All four variants are 100% inorganic fiber, non-combustible, binder free, density 120 ~ 160 Kg/m3 and thickness 3 ~ 20 mm.

- [HAMAT STD](https://ajfibertek.co.in/hamat-std/): E-Glass. Transformation temperature 640°C. Filament diameter 9-13 um. Ignition loss ≤ 2.0%. Volume shrinkage 0%.
- [HAMAT ADV](https://ajfibertek.co.in/hamat-adv/): ECR-Glass. Transformation temperature 761°C. Filament diameter 13-19 um. Ignition loss ≤ 2.0%. Volume shrinkage ≤ 1 %.
- [HAMAT Super](https://ajfibertek.co.in/hamat-super/): Silica Fiber. Transformation temperature 850°C. Filament diameter 7-16 um. Ignition loss ≤ 9.0 %. Volume shrinkage ≤ 8 %.
- [HAMAT ULTRA](https://ajfibertek.co.in/hamat-ultra/): High Silica Fiber. Transformation temperature 1050°C. Filament diameter > 6 um. Ignition loss ≤ 9%. Volume shrinkage Max 7 %.

Insulation product formats: Die Cut by Needle mat, Preform Roving, Preform by Needle Mat, Tubing by Needle Mat.

### Sintered tooling components

Bottom inner punch, Top inner punch, Bottom outer punch, Top outer punch, Core rod, Side core rod, Forming die.

### Medical implant categories

Trauma Plates & Screws, Spine, Hip Fixation, Arthroscopy, Mini Fragment Implants, Knee Plates, Cable Plates, Pediatric Implants.

## Industries and Applications

Automotive (Commercial & Passenger Vehicles) and Non-Automotive (Power, Agriculture, Construction & Infrastructure):

- Exhaust System Components (DOC, DPF, SCR): Heat-resistant insulation for emissions control and thermal management
- Mufflers & Silencers: Effective noise reduction for a quieter driving experience
- Underbody Heat Shields: Protection against high exhaust temperatures for component safety
- EV Battery & Components: Thermal insulation to improve battery safety, lifespan, and performance in electric vehicles

## Manufacturing Capabilities

Stated figures: 1200+ Tonnes Annual Manufacturing Capacity; 98% Client Satisfaction Rate; 30+ OEM & Tier 1 Customers Served; 5+ Countries We Export To; 100% Custom-Built Solutions; 50% Current Capacity utilization.

Manufacturing process, five key steps:

1. Raw Material Receipt — We begin by sourcing and inspecting high-quality fibers for needling.
2. Needling — Fibers are bonded through mechanical needling to form durable, high-performance mats.
3. Cutting — Mats are precisely cut to the required shape and size for each application.
4. Final Inspection — Each product undergoes a thorough quality check to meet strict industry standards.
5. Packing & Shipping — The Complete Packaging Process Overview.

Materials used: E-Glass, ECR, and Silica fibers. HAMAT® insulation is trusted by OEMs across BS IV to BS VII platforms.
